facts.context:
Attack on Titan and Octopath Traveler 0 voice actor Yuki Kaji has returned to host the show, which is said to "offer deep dives into upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, and more."

How long each show will be remains unclear, but we can already think of at least a few games that players are hoping to see.
